name: api-screenshot
description: Self-hosted screenshot API: clean, full-page shots with cookie banners, pop-ups and chat widgets removed.

API_KEY.description: The key every request must carry, 16 characters or more. Make one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and keep it somewhere safe. Until you set your own, the API refuses all screenshots.

CACHE.description: Workers KV, where finished shots are kept for a day so the same request again costs no browser time. The free plan includes 1,000 writes and 100,000 reads a day.

BROWSER.description: [Browser Rendering](https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-rendering/), the headless browser that takes the shots. The free plan includes 10 browser minutes a day.
